text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to roll native-driver v2.4.1 with the new quant fastpath enabled. Target quiet window 03:00-04:00 UTC tonight. Need quick compatibility sweep and rollback plan.

aj: Thanks. Can you confirm which regions and the exact deploybot command you intend to run? Also any thermal/driver caveats?

maria: Regions: us-west1 + eu-central1. Command: `deploybot deploy native-driver:v2.4.1 --regions=us-west1,eu-central1 --canary=10% --quiet-window=03:00-04:00`

maria: Notes: this build swaps matmul kernel and enables quant fastpath by default. We've seen a tiny perf variance in long-seq tests but nothing functional so far.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: job_id=9927, canary=10%, regions=us-west1,eu-central1. ETA canary start: 2026-03-21T03:05:00Z. Links: https://deploys.redwood/job/9927

tariq: Quick checklist: 1) Verify golden image checksum for both regions 2) KV cache warmup script runs 3) Canary metric alarms set (P50, P95 latency, token drop, OOMs).

maria: Checks done except warmup script needs a final run against eu-central1 staging (I can trigger).

sre_oncall: Please add a fallback pin alias in case we need immediate rollback: `alias native-driver:stable -> native-driver:v2.4.0` precreated and tested?

aj: Also set a short TTL on sticky pins during the window (15m). If we see >2% error uplift or P95 increase >20% we do immediate pin rollback.

maria: Agreed. Rollback steps in order: 1) pin alias to v2.4.0 2) throttle canary traffic to 0% 3) force drain current pods 4) open incident and trigger postmortem template. I'll paste commands in thread.

maria: Rollback commands: ```
# pin stable alias
service-control pin native-driver stable native-driver:v2.4.0 --reason "rollback"
# throttle canary
deploybot throttle job_id=9927 --percent=0
# drain
infractl drain --service native-driver --mode=force
```

jen: Can we add a temporary telemetry tag so we can slice requests that hit the fastpath? `X-Exp: fastpath-v2` on canary header. That helps narrow regressions.

maria: Good call — will add header and configure logging filter.

sre_oncall: I'll be watching infra metrics and will notify if any GPU thermal alarms or OOM spikes show up.

deploy-bot: canary started: job_id=9927, step=canary-rollout, started_at=2026-03-21T03:05:12Z

aj: Early telemetry — P50 steady, P95 up +6%, error rate +0.1%. Not alarming but continue monitoring for next 10m.

maria: Kicking warmup for eu-central1 staging now.

aj: After 12 minutes: P95 +18% in eu-central1, token drop rate +1.2% (mostly long-sequence QA flows). Rolling back eu-central1 canary and holding us-west1.

maria: Executing rollback eu-central1 only.

maria: ```
deploybot throttle job_id=9927 --regions=eu-central1 --percent=0
service-control pin native-driver eu-central1 native-driver:v2.4.0 --reason "canary regressions"
```

deploy-bot: throttle applied: job_id=9927, regions=eu-central1, percent=0

sre_oncall: eu-central1 infra showing increased CPU on fallback nodes during drain, but no OOMs. Monitoring.

aj: us-west1 canary still looks fine (P95 +4%). Recommend holding and rerunning a targeted long-seq sim in us-west1 before progressing to full rollout.

maria: Agreed — pausing rollout. Will schedule a longer sim run and reopen thread when we have results. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
